description: Asks which Access-application names the expression service admits when no Access application hosts it (DAO query context): CurrentUser, CurrentDb, Application and CurrentProject members, Forms, Reports and TempVars references, Screen, SysCmd, IsLoaded, HyperlinkPart, the domain aggregates DMax/DMin/DAvg/DFirst/DLast/DStDev/DVar/DSum/DCount/DLookup with and without criteria, and Eval of the function names that were refused directly. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
